Send feedback to the Voidhash team, about the project you are in when there is one. Asks for the
topic and the message on a terminal.

Usage:
  voidhash feedback [message] [flags]

Arguments:
  message  What you want the Voidhash team to know

Flags:
  -h, --help                   Show help for this command
      --json                   Print the API objects as JSON, for scripts
      --sentiment <sentiment>  How you feel, from 1 (unhappy) to 4 (delighted)
      --topic <analytics|paywalls|products|persons|feature-flags|experiments|payment-providers|webhooks|sdk|billing|dashboard|other>
                               What it is about

Global flags:
  -d, --debug              Print each request and full error detail to standard error
      --no-color           Print without colors (also when NO_COLOR is set)
      --profile <profile>  Use a named config profile: its settings override the base config
                           (default: VOIDHASH_PROFILE)

Examples:
  voidhash feedback
  voidhash feedback "Refund events arrive late" --topic webhooks
  voidhash feedback "Love the new charts" --topic analytics --sentiment 4
